verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad API surface: HTTP V2 ingestion, event export, cohort list/export/upload, a Dashboard REST API that returns chart data as JSON, taxonomy CRUD for event types and properties, and Experiment APIs for managing flags, experiments and deployments. A probe found a published OpenAPI spec, and there is an official MCP server. However, nothing shows UI parity: the Dashboard API only reads data, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, API creation/editing of charts, dashboards, notebooks and spaces, programmatic access to session replay, heatmaps, guides/surveys and the visual web-experiment editor, and independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
